{{See also|Progression|Advancements}}
This '''guide for new players''' explains how to begin a world in [[Matcha Flavoured]]. It follows the Tutorial [[Advancements|advancements]], which the pack itself recommends checking when lost: "If you get lost or confused, check the advancements". The README adds that stuck players should also look at the recipes they ''cannot'' craft yet, since recipes unlock as items are picked up.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref>

== Before starting ==
* Install the pack as both a datapack and a resource pack. On loading, chat shows "Matcha Flavoured is now loaded". See [[Installation]].
* Choose the [[difficulty]] with care. On Easy, maximum health never falls below 10 hearts and the [[Wither effect]] takes no hearts. On Normal, each death costs one heart, down to a minimum that drops as the player progresses, and the world switches to Hard once any player's minimum hearts reaches 5. Hard is, in the developer's words, "meant to be unfair".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=Dont play on Hard! Hard is meant to be unfair.}}</ref> The pack only reads the difficulty when the world loads, so a change takes effect after a reload.
* Differences that matter immediately: there is no [[hunger]] and no [[Natural regeneration|natural regeneration]], so the player heals mainly by eating; the inventory is kept on [[death]], but maximum health drops by a heart (two on Hard); [[zombie]]s are fast; [[Day and night|days and nights]] last three times as long; unlit places are pitch black ([[Darkness|true darkness]]); and there are no stone tools.

== Step by step ==
=== 1. Fire ===
Punch a tree. Picking up logs unlocks the recipes for sticks, chests made from logs and [[Kindling|kindling]] (2 sticks above 2 logs of any kind).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/logs.json}}</ref> Kindling is crafted and placed unlit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/campfire.json}}</ref> Craft [[tinder]] from 2 sticks and a piece of short grass, fern or bush, and use it on the kindling. This grants '''Prometheus be Damned'''. Tinder breaks after one use; a [[Fire Starter|fire starter]] (2 flint, which comes from [[gravel]]) lasts longer.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/tinder.json}}</ref>

=== 2. A wooden hoe and dry grass ===
Craft a wooden hoe. Grass broken by hand drops nothing. Broken with a hoe, it drops itself, or [[Wheat Grain|wheat grain]] instead 12.5% of the time; shears also collect it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/short_grass.json}}</ref> Cook short grass or ferns on the lit kindling (10 seconds each) to get short dry grass ('''Harvester''').<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/campfire/short_dry_grass_campfire.json}}</ref> The kindling is also the first cooking station: many ingredients gain their [[intrinsic]] effects when cooked on it ('''Powerful Flavors'''). Food is the only way to heal, so cook early and often.

=== 3. The mud kiln ===
Craft short dry grass with dirt into [[Packed Mud|packed mud]] (one of each makes one), turn 4 packed mud into 4 mud bricks, and build a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] from 4 mud bricks, 2 packed mud and a kindling ('''Ancient Technology''').

=== 4. Copper ===
A wooden pickaxe mines [[Limestone|limestone]], coal and [[Native Copper|native copper]], but gets nothing from deepslate or from iron, gold, silver, diamond or sulfur ores.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/wood.json}}</ref> Smelt raw copper in the kiln ('''Brazier''') and make copper tools and armor. Copper is the first real metal, and the developer wants players to spend time with it.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Copper is cool, let them have more time with it.}}</ref> A copper [[mattock]] or [[dolabra]] saves hotbar space ('''Two in One'''). Obtaining a copper ingot also lowers the player's minimum hearts for the first time (see [[Death#Minimum hearts]]).

=== 5. Stone and the blast furnace ===
The kiln turns cobblestone into [[Limestone|limestone]] and limestone into smooth stone ('''Mason'''). With a copper pickaxe, mine deepslate and craft 4 cobbled deepslate into 4 polished deepslate. A [[blast furnace]] takes 4 polished deepslate, 2 smooth stone and a kindling ('''Burgeoning Metallurge''').

=== 6. Iron, gold, silver and diamonds ===
Copper tools mine [[Hematite|hematite]] (iron) and [[Native Silver|native silver]], but not [[Native Gold|native gold]] or diamond ore; iron tools mine everything except obsidian.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/copper.json}}</ref> Raw iron, raw gold, [[Raw Silver|raw silver]] and [[Raw Diamond|raw diamond]] (what diamond ore drops) can only be smelted in the blast furnace. The first iron ingot and the first diamond each lower minimum hearts again, as do entering [[Hell]], finding a stronghold and obtaining [[Electrum Alloy|electrum]] or [[Adamant Alloy|adamant]] alloy. Progressing slowly keeps deaths cheaper, so there is no need to rush.

=== 7. The oven and meals ===
Clay balls cooked on the kindling or in the kiln become bricks, and 4 bricks craft 2 blocks of bricks. An [[oven]] takes 4 blocks of bricks, 3 iron ingots and a kindling ('''Now You're Cooking''').<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/oven.json}}</ref> Five bricks also make 4 [[bowl]]s ('''Manners First'''), which the curries and ramen, the pack's strongest meals, are served in.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/bowl.json}}</ref> See [[Food]] and [[Cooking]].

=== 8. Steel and smithing ===
Craft 4 iron ingots with a block of coal into 4 [[Carbon-Rich Iron|carbon-rich iron]] and blast each into a [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. Two steel and 4 planks make the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]], and 3 steel and 4 iron ingots make the [[anvil]], which repairs equipment without limit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/smithing_table.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/anvil.json}}</ref> From here the player can apply [[alloy]]s to equipment. See [[Smithing]].

=== 9. Magic materials and Hell ===
Most magic is built on [[Stabilized Estus|stabilized Estus]], crafted from 7 [[Estus Ash|Estus ash]], a [[Benzene|benzene]] and a [[Stable Void|stable void]] (the pack's ender pearl).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/stabilised_estus.json}}</ref> Skeletons (including strays and bogged) and witches drop Estus ash, and [[Raw Estus|raw Estus]] from zombies turns into it when picked up, healing the player. Endermen always drop a stable void when killed by a player. Benzene needs a glass bottle, 3 [[hellspore]] and a [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunk]], so the first one requires a trip to [[Hell]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/benzene.json}}</ref> Entering Hell lowers minimum hearts ('''Orpheus''').

=== 10. Blessings and warding ===
Stabilized Estus and another benzene make a [[Hell-Bound Book|hell-bound book]], which is surrounded with themed ingredients to craft a [[blessing]] with fixed enchantments. There is no enchanting table; see [[Enchanting]]. Stabilized Estus is also the core of the [[Warding Stone|warding stone]], which burns undead and heals villagers and pets around a base.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/warding_stone.json}}</ref> See [[Warding]].

=== 11. The End ===
One stabilized Estus and one [[Divine Fragment|divine fragment]] craft 16 [[Eye of Ender|eyes of ender]], more than a portal needs.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/ender_eye.json}}</ref> Divine fragments come from [[spawner]]s and strong mobs, so break spawners found along the way. Finding a [[stronghold]] lowers minimum hearts again ('''The End of Dreams''').<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/find_stronghold.json}}</ref>

=== 12. After the dragon ===
The first time each player kills the [[Ender Dragon]], a [[Divine Favor|divine favor]] appears above the exit portal, and hostile mobs stop spawning on the Overworld [[surface]] for good.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/first_dragon_killed_reward.mcfunction}}</ref> A divine favor breaks into 9 divine fragments.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/divine_fragment.json}}</ref> The [[Wither]] also drops one and is the renewable source, but it can only be summoned on the Overworld surface. Fragments go into [[Crystal Heart|crystal hearts]], more eyes of ender and [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]] (4 [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]], 4 gold ingots and a fragment), which upgrades diamond gear.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/adamant.json}}</ref> Adamant scrap comes from ancient debris, [[Bastion Remnant|bastion]] chests and piglin brutes.

== Tips ==
* [[Sack]]s (shulker boxes) are available early: 8 [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]] around a chest.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sack.json}}</ref>
* [[Divine Fragment|Divine fragments]] come from breaking [[spawner]]s and defeating strong mobs. They are needed for [[Eye of Ender|eyes of ender]] (1 fragment and 1 stabilized Estus make 16) and [[Crystal Heart|crystal hearts]] (1 fragment and 8 diamonds), so break spawners rather than farming them. The README says simply: "Break Spawners!"
* In the Overworld, only undead mobs can spawn under the open sky; creepers and spiders spawn underground. See [[Spawning]]. [[Warding]] items such as a held [[nazar]] hurt the undead.
* [[Raw Estus|Raw Estus]], dropped by zombies, husks, drowned and zombie villagers, heals the player the moment it is picked up.
* [[Obol]]s are rare. Most villagers do not buy anything, but the [[fisherman]] buys caught [[fish]]. Villagers are not found in villages, which are [[Abandoned village|abandoned]]; they come from [[Asylum Seeker|asylum seeker]] applications sold by the [[Wandering Trader|wandering trader]].
* Carry food suited to the trip: the developer suggests melons for [[Hell]], glow berries or carrots for caves, and chorus fruit for [[the End]].<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If they're planning a trip to hell, they'll want to find some melons first.}}</ref>
* Cold water in snowy biomes is [[Freezing water|freezing]]: keep the head above it.
* There is no rush to reach the End. After the dragon is killed, the surface becomes safe from hostile mobs.
